Water Leak Concern: Head lamp water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Glue application stops intermittently when air pressure drops below 3 bar (air pressure & robot interlink not available).
Countermeasure 1: Robot interlink on air pressure and robot speed parameter control through control plan.
Check Point 1: Confirm glue thickness min 1.5 mm (point captured in PQE control plan).
Check Point 2: Control plan check: Robo interlink (air pressure 4 to 6 bar) & Robo speed parameter adjustment (curing time for each tray 80 to 120 sec) control confirmation.

Water Leak Concern: Rear door pop-up knob clip water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entry restriction structure not available in pop-up knob clip.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Water enters through the relief provided for the snap feature.
Countermeasure 1: Clip changed to closed condition (material added / wall) to avoid water entry.
Check Point 1: Clip should not be opened on water flow path.
Check Point 2: Ensure wall to avoid the water flow.

Water Leak Concern: Sealing screen water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Sealing screen comes off due to harness clip interference with sealing screen (clip to butyl distance was 28.5 mm).
Countermeasure 1: Clip position shifted 70 mm away from the butyl line.
Check Point 1: Harness clip to butyl line distance must be 70 mm.
Check Point 2: Koren Theme std revised from 30 to 70 min based on LLR from PY1B.

Water Leak Concern: Back door body welt water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entry through air vent hole.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Back door hem to body welt distance very low (K2 - 103.5 mm, PB1D - 141.2 mm, PY1B - 65.2 mm).
Countermeasure 1: Body welt air vent hole shifted towards inner side to avoid water entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure distance between back door hemming and body welt is min 100 mm as per NDS Std.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR & RR door glass runner to glass
Issue / Root Cause 1: Glass not going full up due to flock material.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Glass runner mounting panel deformation.
Issue / Root Cause 3: Less retention force (spec >150 N, actual 120 N @ T=1.8 mm).
Countermeasure 1: Flock material removed on glass runner lip (aero lip) to avoid water obscuration and entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure no gap between glass and glass runner at glass fully closed condition (2D drawing confirmation).
Check Point 2: Ensure no flock material on Aero lip.
Check Point 3: Door inner to outer panel should be maintained within spec. Establish control point in POS & update PQAC.

Water Leak Concern: Both side rear door body welt to door inner panel C pillar corner area water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Door body welt overlap with rear door sash tape.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Body welt overlap with surrounding parts: spec 6 +/-2.4 mm, actual 0 mm.
Countermeasure 1: Outer profile revised (18.6 mm removed from top edge) to give required overlap.
Check Point 1: Body welt should not overlap with surrounding parts.
Check Point 2: Testing criteria: 6 +/-2.4 mm.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between both side RR door glass runner to door inner panel near C pillar lower area
Issue / Root Cause 1: BIW - paint sealer not available in drawing at panel joining area.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Trim - gap between sash cover and runner; no water restriction material to arrest water entry.
Countermeasure 1: Paint sealant added at panel joint.
Countermeasure 2: EPT foam added on sash trim / glass runner corner.
Check Point 1: Ensure paint sealant availability on all panel joining areas.
Check Point 2: Ensure water resistance foam availability on trim parts & glass runner corner areas in direct water flow area (design recommendation).

Water Leak Concern: FR & RR door harness & trim pad clip to door inner panel water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entry restriction foam not available in clips.
Countermeasure 1: New clip with washer (P/N 15-53 10701).
Countermeasure 2: 1 mm EPT foam added (0.5 mm compression ratio).
Check Point 1: Ensure water entry restriction material availability on all trim parts & harness clips B-surface area.

Water Leak Concern: FR door body welt to door inner panel water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Door body welt overlaps with outer door handle hole dummy sticker (seal line over sticker).
Issue / Root Cause 2: Dummy sticker hole dia 25 mm (before condition).
Countermeasure 1: Dummy sticker hole changed to oblong 25 x 20 mm so seal line does not overlap.
Check Point 1: Body welt should not overlap with surrounding parts.

Water Leak Concern: Water stagnation between both side rear door sealing screen to door inner panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water drain hole not as per design intent.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Drain hole should be max 1 mm from butyl application path; PY1B actual 5 mm.
Countermeasure 1: Slot changed to hole of dia 15 mm and moved towards -Z direction by 4 mm.
Check Point 1: Door water drain hole & butyl application path distance should be max 1 mm (as per NDS).

Water Leak Concern: Water stagnation between FR & RR door W/strip LWR and side sill
Issue / Root Cause 1: More water entered between front and rear door sash gap because water entry restriction structure was not available.
Countermeasure 1: Dust seal added to reduce water entry in B pillar area through Y direction (example: PY1B).
Check Point 1: Ensure water entry restriction structure between front and rear doors (e.g., B pillar dust seal).

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between both front door mirror locator and door inner panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: Mirror base gasket shrinkage due to more gap (1.5 mm) between mirror base and door sash runner.
Countermeasure 1: Clip & rib added to make interference condition and avoid water entry.
Check Point 1: Mirror base and glass runner gap should be maintained at interference fit condition.
Check Point 2: Ensure mirror base interference with glass runner.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR & RR door glass runner to glass (jet test)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Flock material in aero lip retained water; seepage observed during jet test.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Less retention force (spec >150 N, actual 120 N @ T=1.8 mm).
Countermeasure 1: Flock material removed on glass runner lip to avoid water obscuration and entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure no gap between glass and glass runner at glass fully closed condition (2D drawing confirmation).
Check Point 2: Ensure no flock material on Aero lip.

Water Leak Concern: FR seat mounting area water leak (floor)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No water tightness between dash side and floor joint area - water enters through 6 outrigger holes and travels between floor panel and dash panel into cabin.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Sealer application missed on seat mounting area due to access difficulty.
Countermeasure 1: BIW sealer (permanent sealer, extrusion) applied between side wall and floor panel to avoid water entry into cabin.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealant application in all panel joining areas.

Water Leak Concern: Rear wiper grommet to wiper hose water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entered between wiper hose and wiper grommet: gap between grommet and hose.
Issue / Root Cause 2: No control on wiper hose orientation (routing) between two grommets.
Issue / Root Cause 3: Washer hose routing different from RBC due to packaging constraints.
Countermeasure 1: Wiper washer hose position tilted.
Countermeasure 2: Hose length reduced 140+/-10 to 110+/-10 mm.
Countermeasure 3: Grommet hose insertion overlap increased from 2 to 5 mm.
Check Point 1: Ensure washer hose orientation tangential & grommet overlap (HBC reference 5 mm).

Water Leak Concern: Rear wiper grommet to BIW water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: 0.3 mm gap between grommet and roof panel.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Grommet has no Z interface with BIW (only X & Y control).
Issue / Root Cause 3: Very little hand space to assemble (back door edge to grommet edge 0 mm vs RBC 10 mm); >50% leaking grommets were not fitted well.
Countermeasure 1: 0.65 mm material added to grommet to give 0.35 mm interference with BIW.
Check Point 1: Ensure grommet interference condition with BIW panel without gap.
Check Point 2: Ensure Koran Theme OK (back door edge to grommet edge 10 mm clearance in X direction).

Water Leak Concern: All door sealing screen water leak (screen peeling)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Sealing screen peels because screen is flat and does not follow door profile.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Butyl application surface not even.
Countermeasure 1: Screen thickness 100 to 200 micron.
Countermeasure 2: Screen formed to follow door profile.
Check Point 1: Ensure butyl application surface is flat and even throughout (without many bends).
Check Point 2: Ensure sealing screen follows door profile.

Water Leak Concern: All door sealing screen water leak (3M tape near pop-up knob)
Issue / Root Cause 1: 3M tape adhesive not enough; it easily comes off near pop-up knob area, leading to water leak.
Countermeasure 1: Butyl added instead of 3M tape for proper sealing.
Check Point 1: Ensure groove for butyl application till top without any intervals.
Check Point 2: Ensure sealing screen covers entire water exposure region.

Water Leak Concern: 'C' pillar trim water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Door metal sash sealer not throughout.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Door sash cover to runner has more gap.
Issue / Root Cause 3: Rat hole between metal sash and runner.
Countermeasure 1: Sealer added till top of metal sash.
Countermeasure 2: Sash length increased 20 mm.
Countermeasure 3: Foam added to avoid water entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealer application throughout the sash (joining).
Check Point 2: Ensure glass runner to section molding at interference condition without gap.
Check Point 3: Ensure glass runner interference with BIW panel without any gap.

Water Leak Concern: Roof rail water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: 3 mm foam pad not compressed in locator area because roof rail metal insert is not in contact with roof rail (0.5 mm gap).
Issue / Root Cause 2: Roof rail rib absent at roof rail locking area.
Countermeasure 1: Foam thickness increased 3 to 4 mm.
Countermeasure 2: DSA tape added for proper bonding & interference with panel.
Check Point 1: Ensure roof rail metal insert proper contact with roof rail without gap to transfer load to tape/foam.
Check Point 2: Ensure roller application for bonding process.

Water Leak Concern: Spoiler all bolt water leak (only at negative pressure test)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Spoiler bolt head has serration on flange surface, leading to water entry during negative pressure test.
Countermeasure 1: Bolt changed to pilot type bolt without serration on bolt head flange.
Check Point 1: Ensure flat flange + pilot type bolts are used.

Water Leak Concern: All door body welt leak (due to position change)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Body welt joining position was on side wall surface on water path (A & B pillar zone), leading to water entry into cabin.
Countermeasure 1: Body welt joining position shifted to bottom side (sill side).
Check Point 1: Ensure there is a single mould without any joining (or).
Check Point 2: Ensure body welt joining is at bottom side (sill side).

Water Leak Concern: FR LH trim pad water leak (outside mirror snap)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entry restriction foam not available in clips.
Countermeasure 1: Water prevention foam added on harness clip.
Check Point 1: Ensure water restriction foam on harness clip.

Water Leak Concern: All door trim pad water leak (E1 variant) - dummy sticker missing
Issue / Root Cause 1: For E1 variant, dummy sticker not provided where harness comes in other variants (front door latch harness clip 1 no., rear door 4 nos.).
Countermeasure 1: Dummy stickers required for E1 variant: FR RH/LH door 1 no. each.
Countermeasure 2: RR RH/LH door 4 nos. each.
Check Point 1: Ensure dummy sticker or plug available for unused holes for all variants.

Water Leak Concern: FR RH door trim pad water leak (harness)
Issue / Root Cause 1: RH speaker harness shorter than LH (RH 350 mm vs LH 385 mm) - drawing wrongly updated vs CAD.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Short harness pulls & stretches sealing screen.
Countermeasure 1: RH side harness length corrected to same as LH, as per CAD.
Check Point 1: Ensure both side harness at same length.
Check Point 2: Ensure harness CAD & 2D drawing have the same dimension.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak in HVAC air intake area due to high pressure jet direct hit
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Design requirement: cowl grid hole 100 mm away from HVAC inlet; actual 50 mm.
Countermeasure 1: Cowl grid hole location changed to 100 mm away from HVAC inlet.
Check Point 1: Ensure cowl grid hole location 100 mm away from HVAC inlet as per BMIR Std.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between back door inner panel to door trim
Issue / Root Cause 1: Unused hole in back door inner panel.
Countermeasure 1: Plug introduced to avoid water leak.
Check Point 1: Ensure plug or sticker availability for unused holes.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between back door finisher to camera assembly
Issue / Root Cause 1: Poor sealing between back door finisher and camera assembly - no sealing prevention.
Countermeasure 1: Water prevention foam added between camera bracket and embellisher.
Countermeasure 2: Water prevention foam added between camera and camera bracket.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention foam between camera bracket and embellisher.
Check Point 2: Ensure water prevention foam between camera and camera bracket.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between back door finisher to door OTR panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: Poor sealing application between back door finisher and door OTR panel (gap between back door and finisher).
Countermeasure 1: Water prevention foam added between back door embellisher and back door panel.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention foam around embellisher with interference condition to avoid water leak.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between back door inner panel to door trim (OTR/INR joint)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No paint sealant application in OTR and INR panel joint.
Countermeasure 1: Body sealant applied between inner & outer panel.
Check Point 1: Ensure body sealer availability between inner and outer panel.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between back door OTR panel to HMSL lamp
Issue / Root Cause 1: Sealing between HMSL lamp and back door OTR panel not sufficient (gap between HMSL and back door panel).
Countermeasure 1: Double side tape applied to reduce locking reaction force of ribs.
Check Point 1: Ensure double side tape availability.
Check Point 2: Ensure double side tape at interference condition with panel for proper bonding.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between dash panel to dummy grommet
Issue / Root Cause 1: Dummy grommet was non-waterproof.
Countermeasure 1: Changed to water prevention grommet.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention grommet availability.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR wheel arch to fuel pipeline mounting bolt
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention around the stud.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied around the stud.
Check Point 1: Ensure weld type bolt & ensure sealer surrounding the stud.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR floor area seat mounting to floor panel near inspection cover (nut)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealant application around nut.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied around the stud.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealant application around the nut.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR floor area seat mounting to floor panel near inspection cover (stud bolt)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealant application around stud bolt.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied around the stud.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealant application around the stud bolt.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR floor area seat mounting to floor panel (nut)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealant application around nut.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied around the stud.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealant application around the stud.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR floor area seat mounting to floor panel (open hole)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Direct water entry between floor joints - open hole in bracket.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied on the open hole.
Check Point 1: Ensure no open hole (or).
Check Point 2: Ensure paint sealant application for open hole.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR seat mounting bolt to floor panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant applied around the stud.
Check Point 1: Ensure paint sealant availability around the bolt.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door glass runner to door inner panel near A pillar area (mirror mounting)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention in mirror mounting.
Countermeasure 1: Gasket seal added between mirror base and door sash panel.
Check Point 1: Ensure sealant application between OVRM panel to reinforcement panel.
Check Point 2: Ensure water prevention sealing between mirror base to door sash panel.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door glass runner to door inner panel near A pillar area (water behind glass runner)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention in mirror mounting (without water prevention sealing).
Countermeasure 1: Gasket added between mirror base and door sash panel (OVRM).
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention sealing between mirror base to door sash panel.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door sealing screen to harness routing above the speaker
Issue / Root Cause 1: Harness routing guiding the water route (harness routed from top to bottom).
Countermeasure 1: Harness branch position changed.
Countermeasure 2: Harness routing from bottom to top.
Check Point 1: Ensure the harness branch position (harness routing from bottom to top).
Check Point 2: Ensure the slit cut position.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door sealing screen to harness routing near door inner handle
Issue / Root Cause 1: Harness routing guiding the water route (harness routed from top to bottom).
Countermeasure 1: Harness branch position changed.
Countermeasure 2: Harness routing from bottom to top.
Check Point 1: Ensure the harness branch position (harness routing from bottom to top).
Check Point 2: Ensure the slit cut position.

Water Leak Concern: Water / dust entry risk in FR door inner panel to cabin
Issue / Root Cause 1: Unused hole in FR door inner panel without any plug or sticker.
Countermeasure 1: Temp: sticker applied.
Countermeasure 2: Perm: hole deleted.
Check Point 1: Ensure no unused holes without dummy plug or tape.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage risk in FR door inner panel to dummy hole
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention from door inner panel side dummy hole.
Countermeasure 1: Sticker applied.
Check Point 1: Ensure no unused holes without dummy plug or tape.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door speaker to door inner panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: Improper torque application: design 5.6 to 8.4 Nm, actual 1.2 Nm (spinning happened due to high torque).
Countermeasure 1: Water leak prevention foam changed same as GO2A.
Countermeasure 2: Tool RPM revised 1500 to 700 RPM.
Countermeasure 3: Torque spec revised from 8 to 2.6 Nm.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention foam surrounding the speaker.
Check Point 2: Ensure foam at interference condition with panel to avoid water entry.
Check Point 3: Ensure torque for speaker mounting 2.6 Nm (reference RBC).

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door harness clip to door inner panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention.
Countermeasure 1: Water preventing foam added on all clips.
Check Point 1: Ensure water preventing foam around the clips to avoid water leak.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between RR door C pillar area B/OTR panel to body side W/strip
Issue / Root Cause 1: Less reaction force of body side W/strip seal structure - bulb profile has poor contact with door inner panel.
Countermeasure 1: Compression load deflection (CLD) of quarter glass seal increased from 2.5 N/100 mm to 9.6 N/100 mm.
Check Point 1: Ensure W/strip seal bulb at interference condition with door inner panel.
Check Point 2: Ensure the QTR glass seal CLD value (reference 9.6 N/100 mm).

Water Leak Concern: Water leak in RR bumper - hole behind bumper bracket
Issue / Root Cause 1: No hole cover application (no dummy sticker or plug).
Countermeasure 1: Tape / dummy sticker introduced to avoid water entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure no unused holes.
Check Point 2: Ensure dummy plug or tape availability for unused holes.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR door harness clip to door inner panel (repeat)
Issue / Root Cause 1: No sealing prevention.
Countermeasure 1: Water preventing foam added on all clips.
Check Point 1: Ensure water preventing foam around the clips to avoid water leak.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through water box (air intake inlet)
Issue / Root Cause 1: Current stopper height not sufficient (25 mm in Z direction) and not till end in X direction.
Countermeasure 1: Stopper height increased from 25 to 37 mm in Z direction and extended till end in X direction.
Check Point 1: Ensure stopper height min 37 mm (reference XBA) in Z direction & till end in X direction.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak between HVAC mounting to ENCON inner panel water box area
Issue / Root Cause 1: Dash insulator overlapping with heater hose foam (HVAC foam is waterproof, dash insulator is not).
Countermeasure 1: Dash insulator size modified (reduced 15 mm) to remove overlap condition.
Check Point 1: Ensure there is no overlapping between dash insulator & heater hose foam.

Water Leak Concern: Back door hinge area water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Washer is 0.4 mm under flush compared to hinge, leading to water entry.
Countermeasure 1: 2 washers added at hinge bottom.
Check Point 1: Ensure hinge surface is on flat surface.
Check Point 2: Ensure expandable foam (or) ensure washer over-flush condition compared to hinge.

Water Leak Concern: Luggage room area water leak flange
Issue / Root Cause 1: No joggle.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Panel gap ~4 mm against requirement of max 2 mm and not even throughout, leading to more gap and sealer bubbles.
Countermeasure 1: Finishing method changed from spatula to brushing.
Countermeasure 2: Panel gap minimised before spot using jig.
Check Point 1: Ensure panel gap is less than 2 mm & even throughout.
Check Point 2: Ensure joggle availability for even sealer application.

Water Leak Concern: Dash panel - cowl plug area water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Stamping emboss flat surface (28 mm dia) smaller than plug (32 mm dia).
Issue / Root Cause 2: Plug seating uneven at edges, leading to water entry.
Countermeasure 1: Stamping emboss flat surface increased to 43.2 mm (check-point picture shows 42 mm).
Countermeasure 2: Plug dia remains 32 mm.
Check Point 1: Ensure plug seating stamping emboss flat surface is bigger than plug dia for even seating throughout.

Water Leak Concern: Dash panel cowl top area water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: ~8 mm gap between panel joining area.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Body seal has lump after application which stops coverage of paint seal.
Countermeasure 1: Apply body seal between dash and side member.
Countermeasure 2: Remove body seal and apply paint seal for good application.
Check Point 1: Ensure there is no hole (max 2 mm).
Check Point 2: Ensure sealer application at panel joining area.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through fuel inspection cover
Issue / Root Cause 1: Sealant got disturbed during adjustment - no position mark exists.
Countermeasure 1: Sealant size changed from 4 mm to 6 mm.
Check Point 1: Ensure there is a position mark to avoid misalignment.
Check Point 2: Ensure groove availability for sealant application.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through key cylinder
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water entry between back door key cylinder and back door panel (through key entry slot).
Countermeasure 1: Washer added.
Countermeasure 2: Drain plate / bracket fixed behind key cylinder to re-route water flow to drain hole.
Check Point 1: Confirm water routing bracket availability.
Check Point 2: Confirm EPD seal presence.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through FR door sealing screen to inner pop-up rod
Issue / Root Cause 1: Water enters between body and outside handle gap and comes out through sealing screen pop-up knob routing hole (sealing screen lower than body & outside handle hole).
Countermeasure 1: Pop-up knob routed to top of the sealing screen.
Countermeasure 2: Hole eliminated.
Check Point 1: Ensure pop-up knob routing is at top of the sealing screen without any hole to avoid water entry.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage from RR bumper mounting bracket locate pin
Issue / Root Cause 1: No water leak prevention foam surrounding the locate pin.
Countermeasure 1: Water prevention foam added.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention foam around the locating pin.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through FR / RR door trim sealing screen
Issue / Root Cause 1: Only 4 to 5 mm of sealing screen remains after butyl.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Screen wrinkles after pasting due to small size, causing workability issue.
Countermeasure 1: Sealing screen size increased - 10 mm after butyl path.
Check Point 1: Ensure min 10 mm sealing screen remains after the butyl, to avoid butyl application at edge.

Water Leak Concern: Water leakage between FR seat buckle mounting bolt to floor panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: Paint sealant is missing.
Countermeasure 1: Paint sealant added.
Check Point 1: Ensure paint sealant availability on seat buckle mounting bolts.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak between RR bumper mounting pin to body panel near latch lower
Issue / Root Cause 1: No water-tight seal around the mounting pin.
Countermeasure 1: Water prevention EPDM seal added around the mounting pin.
Check Point 1: Ensure water prevention seal around the mounting pin.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak in hole behind rear bumper
Issue / Root Cause 1: No tape or plug to prevent water entry (unused hole).
Countermeasure 1: Temp: tape added on unused hole.
Countermeasure 2: Perm: metal part tool modified to remove the punch.
Check Point 1: Ensure there is no unused hole (or).
Check Point 2: Ensure tape availability on unused holes.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak through suspension and body
Issue / Root Cause 1: Gap between upper and lower panel - thickness mismatch (upper 1 mm, lower 1.8 mm).
Issue / Root Cause 2: Gap created after welding leads to water leak.
Countermeasure 1: Washer added below lower panel.
Countermeasure 2: Rubber compression preload increased by reducing metal sleeve length (31 to 28.5 mm).
Check Point 1: Ensure BIW top cup thickness & lower panel thickness are the same.
Check Point 2: Ensure cup washer availability, which will increase deflection of water entry.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak between drafter case and flap
Issue / Root Cause 1: No backflow prevention structure.
Countermeasure 1: Air drafter case flap angle set to min 10 degree or more (outside tilt, no puddle).
Check Point 1: Confirm drafter case flap angle >10 degree to avoid water entry.

Water Leak Concern: Water leak between LH sill and LH floor panel
Issue / Root Cause 1: 6 mm gap between floor and sill.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Difficult to apply paint sealing.
Countermeasure 1: Panel gap reduced to 2 +/-1 mm.
Check Point 1: Confirm the gap between floor and sill <3 mm.
Check Point 2: General design NDS requirement in this area is 2 +/-1 mm.

Water Leak Concern: LH combi lamp area water leak - parking sensor grommet around leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Parking sensor harness mounting clip has no foam seal.
Countermeasure 1: Water resistance material added on clip to make more interference with body panel.
Check Point 1: Confirm all harness clips water resistance material availability.

Water Leak Concern: FR LH roof molding clip leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Clip length short, creating gap between roof moulding clip and panel.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Clip sometimes broken.
Countermeasure 1: Clip locking structure increased 5 mm to avoid play & water entry.
Check Point 1: Ensure no clearance between roof moulding clip and roof panel clip locking hole.
Check Point 2: Confirm water resistance foam availability between clip and metal panel (NDS requirement).

Water Leak Concern: Back door finisher area water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Gap created between body panel and back door finisher - no water tightness seal.
Countermeasure 1: EPT foam added on back door finisher B surface (12 x 8 x 140 mm).
Check Point 1: Confirm water resistance foam availability on back door finisher (handle) with interference condition.

Water Leak Concern: Rear wiper washer nozzle O-ring leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: O-ring details wrongly updated in drawing (1.7 +/-0.5 mm) vs CAD (1.7 +0.05 mm).
Issue / Root Cause 2: O-ring material has uneven cross section & flashes (uneven contact).
Countermeasure 1: O-ring spec corrected to 1.7 +0.05 mm to make more interference with HMSL.
Check Point 1: Confirm the O-ring specification as per drawing & CAD.

Water Leak Concern: RR both door sealing screen cup area leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Seal lines not robust to provide water tightness.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Water bypasses butyl seal through emboss lip excess flange.
Countermeasure 1: Weld between sealing screen & cup done to avoid excess flange interference with butyl path (slide text says cabin side; check point says door trim side - verify).
Check Point 1: Butyl pasting path should be in single PE film - no interference by sealing screen shape & component.
Check Point 2: All sealing screen cups should be welded from the door trim side to avoid overlap of cup excess flange interfering with butyl pasting path.

Water Leak Concern: RR bumper bracket water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Gap between bumper bracket and body panel (missed foam, bracket snap broken/reworked).
Countermeasure 1: Foam (3 mm thickness) added to avoid gap between bracket and panel.
Countermeasure 2: New bracket with pre-fixing snap.
Check Point 1: Check bumper bracket to body panel interference condition.

Water Leak Concern: Back door finisher to rear camera water leak - negative pressure
Issue / Root Cause 1: Not stated explicitly (check points only) - camera datum / foam / harness hole sealing risks at negative pressure.
Countermeasure 1: Camera seal to have 0.5 mm interference with finisher.
Countermeasure 2: Grommet lock on camera harness body hole.
Check Point 1: RR view camera fixing datum should be clearly defined in X, Y and Z.
Check Point 2: Camera foam should have full sealing even in worst case assembly variation (min 0.5 mm interference).
Check Point 3: Back door camera harness entry hole should have water tightness locking grommet.

Water Leak Concern: HMSL to body panel water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Complicated mounting structure of HMSL lamp assembly.
Countermeasure 1: COD of mating parts validated for worst case interference in design lot.
Countermeasure 2: D-note hole tolerance followed by stamping shop.
Check Point 1: COD confirmation for worst case interference if mating parts disturb water tightness seal.
Check Point 2: CAD data and supplier part drawing nominal should match.
Check Point 3: Stamping shop should follow the CAD tolerance provided for the hole in D-note.

Water Leak Concern: All doors speaker water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: Speaker absorbing paper non-waterproof.
Issue / Root Cause 2: Water resistance foam not available in spacer.
Countermeasure 1: Water protection spacer (proposed, with protector) and water-resistant speaker material.
Check Point 1: Speaker diaphragm must be made of water resistance material to avoid water entry into cabin.
Check Point 2: Check amount of water flow inside door inner panel by confirming distance between door inner to outer panel.
Check Point 3: Confirm water flow rate w.r.t. panel gap & water resistance material availability on speaker.
Check Point 4: Validate door speaker absorbing paper is water-proof (water test standard 36-10-008; BIMR Rule No 1 # BMIR-V0620-2005-0007 V3.0).

Water Leak Concern: Both front door PTN sash water leak
Issue / Root Cause 1: 0.39 mm gap between PTN sash glass runner corner and BIW.

Countermeasure 2: 2~3 mm EPT foam added to make 0.39 mm interference with BIW.

Check Point 2: Ensure water resistance material availability on glass runner corners (direct water contact areas).
